label: Example Neocloud - cluster A - 2026-09-20

findings.title: Unauthenticated Ray dashboard / Jobs API exposed
findings.detail: HTTP 200 without authentication on port 8265 (no TLS)
findings.remediation: Enable Ray authentication or bind the dashboard to loopback/a private subnet; never expose port 8265 publicly.

cves_unconfirmed.why: Fixed in Ray 2.52.0, and this scan did not determine your version.

findings.title: TLS certificate fails verification
findings.remediation: Replace the certificate with one issued by a trusted CA, matching the service hostname and within its validity window.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Ollama API exposed
findings.detail: HTTP 200 without authentication on port 11434 (no TLS)
findings.remediation: Restrict the Ollama API (11434) to localhost/trusted networks.

grade_reason: A critical exposure is reachable: Unauthenticated Ray dashboard / Jobs API exposed. Reaching it is sufficient to run code on it: remote code execution by the software's own design, not a misconfiguration of yours.
